summary.work_completed: Authored 12 contract-first regression tests across 7 unit test files and 1 E2E spec for Bug #88 — all interactive elements non-functional. Tests are RED on current scaffold and will turn GREEN after coding agent wires event handlers.
key_findings: Scaffold hooks (useBrickPlacement, useKeyboardShortcuts, useUndoRedo) return no-op stubs
BrickPalette.tsx and Toolbar.tsx have no onClick handlers connected to Zustand stores
Viewport.tsx does not spread useBrickPlacement pointer handlers onto R3F Canvas
useKeyboardShortcuts.ts is not mounted in App.tsx or Viewport.tsx
CSS pointer-events or z-index overlay may be blocking interactions

human_review_required.reason: Selectors use aria-label and data-testid patterns; coding agent must add these attributes to components
E2E tests rely on window.__legoApp; coding agent must ensure this is set in main.tsx dev mode

recommended_actions: Wire useBrickPlacement hook: implement onPointerDown/Move/Up calling placementEngine; spread onto R3F Canvas in Viewport.tsx
Wire Toolbar.tsx: connect Undo/Redo to useUndoRedo(); Clear to sceneStore.clearScene(); Export to export service
Wire BrickPalette.tsx: add onClick handlers calling uiStore.setActiveBrickType() and setActiveBrickColor()
Mount useKeyboardShortcuts() in App.tsx with handlers for R, Delete, Escape, Ctrl+Z/Y
Check index.css and component styles for pointer-events: none on canvas container
Ensure window.__legoApp is set in main.tsx dev mode with sceneStore, uiStore, selectionStore
Add data-testid and aria-label attributes to toolbar buttons and palette items
